command.mxt_test.cultivate.success: Qingxiao breathing has begun. The crystal is consumed as hidden aura fuel.
command.mxt_test.guide.1: Qingxiao Trial: 1. Run /mxt_test kit to receive the identity, resources, and tools.
command.mxt_test.guide.2: 2. Hold a Qingxiao Spirit Crystal and run /mxt_test cultivate. Then use /mxt breakthrough mxt_test:qi to test advancement.
command.mxt_test.guide.3: 3. Use the formation plate on a gold block, bind a wolf with the contract scroll, and enter the End trial using the realm token.
command.mxt_test.guide.4: 4. Use /mxt ability cast mxt_test:qingxiao_firebolt to test abilities, and /mxt attachment status to inspect the player's runtime state.
command.mxt_test.kit.realm_failed: Could not initialize the Qingxiao realm. Use this command on a fresh test character.
command.mxt_test.kit.success: Qingxiao trial kit granted. Hold a Qingxiao Spirit Crystal, then run /mxt_test cultivate. The artifacts are already bound: the Azure Frost Flying Sword carries its holder, and the Spirit Gathering Jade holds 27 slots.
command.mxt_test.verify.aura_ok: Aura zone priority rule is consistent with the resolved environment.
command.mxt_test.verify.cost_ok: Unified costs: a resource and an aura in one array add up, an unpayable entry takes nothing, and a missing channel or a bad number is reported as itself.
command.mxt_test.verify.minor_stage_ok: Minor-stage cuts match the fixture's numbers.
command.mxt_test.verify.names_ok: Generated names and descriptions match the entry ids.
command.mxt_test.verify.targets_ok: target selectors: cap, order, cone angle and the ray stopping at a block all hold
command.mxt_test.verify.wheel_ok: wheel extension: a registered page and kind read back by id, take part in the numbering, and travel by id
command.mxt_test.verify.closure_ok: C-group closure: the slot field is refused, sprite regions and sizes, a rule's chance and cooldown, the item-ability producer, the structure check policy, the upkeep bill, timeline branching and timeouts, and shared formation ownership
command.mxt_test.verify.talisman_ok: talisman: the declared cap sums into the vanilla components and its bar, every invocation takes its cost off, the one past the cap destroys the carrier and hands back what it never burned, a price that cannot be paid refuses the invocation and one that can is settled, and a declared tier resolves through the quality module
command.mxt_test.verify.ability_cooldown: ability state: a cooldown keeps running after the item that granted it is put away, while the other kinds such as charges still go with the source
condition.mxt_test.item_condition_probe: Item identity probe: the held item is a named physique, technique, spirit root or talisman
condition.mxt_test.locked_carrot: This item cannot be used right now
mxt.contract_type.mxt_test.master_servan: A master-servant pact: signing it costs spirit power. Every blow the beast lands sets its target on fire; releasing the pact leaves the beast weakened, and a beast that dies burns on its way out.
mxt.contract_type.mxt_test.open_contract: A contract with no strings attached: no conditions, no price and no extra behaviour, and only one beast at a time.
mxt.quality.mxt_test.spirit_iron.descrip: Cast from spirit iron, better than common iron.
mxt.alchemy_furnace.mxt_test.alchemy/dua: Dark Bronze quality; two main and two auxiliary slots. Walls and the heat block determine its temperature limit.
mxt.alchemy_furnace.mxt_test.alchemy/sea: Exercises refusal when quality conditions fail.
mxt.alchemy_furnace.mxt_test.alchemy/sma: One main slot and no auxiliary slots.
mxt.alchemy_furnace.mxt_test.alchemy/wid: Two main, two auxiliary, one catalyst; quality names do not determine furnace parameters.
mxt.quality.mxt_test.alchemy/kiln_a.desc: A custom furnace quality, not a numeric furnace tier.
mxt.quality.mxt_test.alchemy/kiln_b.desc: A different quality; overriding quality does not change the furnace specification.
mxt.quality.mxt_test.alchemy/sealed.desc: A test quality whose use condition is always false.
mxt.medicinal_property.mxt_test.alchemy/: An unrequested property prevents every recipe that does not require it from matching.
mxt.medicinal_property.mxt_test.herb/mai: Main potency scales with the actual item count for substitution checks.
mxt.medicinal_property.mxt_test.herb/aux: Auxiliary potency is separate from the main role.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.fire_ginseng.de: The existing herb retains its default age, quality, and classification tags.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.alchemy/weed.de: Exercises refusal for an extra medicinal property.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/a.descript: Potency uses herb_age in its formula; age is not multiplied a second time.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/aging.desc: Its growth rate reads the plant's own age: 2 + herb_age every period.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/b.descript: Exercises equivalent potency from a different item.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/c.descript: Supplies auxiliary potency and contributes to quantity-weighted balance.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/d.descript: Supplies catalyst power without shifting thermal balance.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/grower.des: Exercises planting, mature harvest, and seed recovery.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/payer.desc: Growth draws from the shared local environmental aura pool.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/partial.de: An unaffordable group of aura costs must not make a partial payment.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/blocked.de: An unmet environment condition pauses growth and payment.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/retired.de: The file is shipped but excluded at load. A saved plot whose definition is absent stops growing and still returns its seed.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/rolled.des: Growth and costs are each evaluated once per period.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.herb/tiered.des: Poor from age 10 and excellent from 30; below the lowest rung nothing is stamped.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.toxicity.description: Adds 25 toxicity; reaching 100 triggers overdose and resets it to 20.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.limited.description: The pill whose binding exercises lifetime use limits and cooldown boundaries.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.hungry.description: Checks before use; changed post-consume values must not discard a legal effect.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.reenter.description: A callback cannot settle the same consumed dose twice.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.blocked.description: Failed use conditions preserve the item, remainder, and use count.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.disabled_ref.descripti: The file is shipped but excluded at load: the registry does not contain it, and any definition naming it fails the whole load. The probe builds a keyed holder with no value to exercise the refusal.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.red_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #E53935, 1 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.orange_pill.descriptio: Tint test pill: colour #FB8C00, 2 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.yellow_pill.descriptio: Tint test pill: colour #FDD835, 3 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.green_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #43A047, 4 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.cyan_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #00ACC1, 5 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.blue_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #3949AB, 6 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.pink_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #EC407A, 7 toxicity per dose.
mxt.pill.mxt_test.black_pill.description: Tint test pill: colour #1B1B1B, 8 toxicity per dose.
Honey bottles and suspicious stew are both this toxicity test pill.
mxt.pill_binding.mxt_test.limited_pill.d: Lifetime use limit and cooldown for the sweet berries item.
mxt.alchemy_wall_material.mxt_test.alche: Test wall rated to 200. The furnace limit is the lowest of the 18 walls.
Test wall rated to 80. It caps the whole furnace even if the other walls and the heat block are hotter.
mxt.medicinal_property.mxt_test.alchemy/: Separates the unreachable high-temperature rule from the daily mixture.
Identifies the short paper batch without changing the daily practice mixture.
Shared by two equal demands so neither can dominate.
A separate dominance ladder that the daily mixture does not contain.
Identifies the batch that writes an ambient aura threshold.
Identifies the batch whose aura threshold can never be met.
Identifies the batch that yields a condition-gated pill.
Identifies the batch that yields a reentrant-callback pill.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.alchemy/rank.de: One rank mark; two items meet the higher demand.
mxt.spirit_herb.mxt_test.alchemy/mark_pi: One fasting pill mark; thermally neutral.
One reentrant pill mark; thermally neutral.
command.mxt_test.sword_aura.spawned: Spawned %s test swords for 10 minutes; test large grids in open air. Clear with /mxt_test sword_aura clear.
